_comment: Legal page content. DRAFTED, NOT LAWYER-REVIEWED. Every factual claim about data handling was verified against the actual code on 2026-09-05: no cookies, no localStorage, no analytics, no trackers; the only third party contacted is the Google Apps Script form endpoint; fonts are self-hosted. If the site's behaviour changes (adding analytics, a cookie banner, a CRM), this file must change with it.

pages.name: Privacy Policy
pages.title: Privacy Policy | TANVO
pages.metaDescription: How TANVO collects, uses and protects personal data submitted through tanvo.in. We set no cookies and run no analytics or advertising trackers.
pages.lede: What we collect, why we collect it, and what you can ask us to do with it.

p: TANVO is a digital strategy, design and development studio based in Hubli–Dharwad, Karnataka, India. This policy covers the website at www.tanvo.in.
For anything in this policy, contact us at support@tanvo.in.
We set no cookies. We run no analytics, advertising or behavioural tracking of any kind. The only personal data we receive is what you deliberately type into our enquiry form and send us.
When you submit the project enquiry form, we receive exactly the fields you filled in:
ul: Your phone number, if you choose to provide it — this field is optional
The page address you submitted from
p2: When you simply visit the site, our hosting provider records standard server logs, which include IP address, browser user-agent, requested page and timestamp. This is ordinary web-server operation and we do not use it to build a profile of you.
We do not ask for, want, or knowingly store any special category data — health, financial, biometric or similar. Please do not include such information in your project brief.

p: Solely to read your enquiry, reply to it, and keep a record of business correspondence. We do not sell personal data. We do not share it for advertising. We do not use it to train machine-learning models.

Enquiry submissions are transmitted over HTTPS to a Google Apps Script endpoint under our control, which records them in a Google Sheet in our Google Workspace account and sends a notification email to support@tanvo.in. Access is limited to TANVO personnel who need it to respond to you.
The site is hosted on Vercel, which processes server logs as described above.
Typefaces are served from our own domain rather than a third-party font service, so no font provider receives your IP address when you visit.
That is the complete list of third parties. There are no others.

We keep enquiry records for as long as they remain useful for the business relationship or correspondence they relate to, and delete them when they no longer are. You can ask us to erase your enquiry at any time and we will do so unless we are legally required to keep it.
Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, and comparable laws elsewhere, you may ask us to:
ul: Confirm what personal data of yours we hold, and give you a copy
Erase your data where we have no continuing need for it
Withdraw consent you previously gave, without affecting processing already carried out
p2: Email support@tanvo.in and we will respond within 30 days. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India. If you are in the UK or EEA, you may complain to your local supervisory authority.

p: The site is served only over HTTPS with HSTS. Form submissions travel over TLS. We apply a Content Security Policy and related protective headers. Records are held in access-controlled Google Workspace accounts.
No system is perfectly secure, and we will not claim otherwise. If we become aware of a breach affecting your personal data, we will notify you and the relevant authority as required by law.

This site is aimed at businesses and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 18. If you believe a child has sent us personal data, email us and we will delete it.

If we change what we collect or who we share it with, we will update this page and change the effective date above. Material changes to how we handle data already collected will be notified to affected individuals where we hold contact details.
